cautions: Selecting best SN_R within each night was determined before looking at the colour; all nights are retained.
MASK=0 and finite positive IVAR are required; no camera is independently rescaled to enforce agreement.
Same instrument and shared Pan-STARRS anchors leave correlated calibration errors; calibrated-night agreement is a stability diagnostic.
Per-pixel uncertainties and plotted bands omit coherent calibration errors, inter-pixel covariance and uncertainty in the normalization. They are not total-error significance intervals.
A shape discrepancy or colour difference is not an intrinsic-variability detection.
Catalogued valid-arm fractions are only an initial selection; actual cframe masks are retained and rechecked.
calibration_gate: Require maximum gri residual <0.15 mag and absolute tilt <0.25 mag/1000 A; numerical convergence alone is insufficient. Complete colour additionally requires spectrum coverage_eligible.
